deletion_requests_resolution_check.name: deletion_requests_resolution_check
deletion_requests_resolution_check.value: ("deletion_requests"."status" <> 'resolved' AND "deletion_requests"."resolution_note" IS NULL AND "deletion_requests"."resolved_by" IS NULL AND "deletion_requests"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("deletion_requests"."status" = 'resolved' AND "deletion_requests"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "deletion_requests"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deletion_requests"."resolution_note" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("deletion_requests"."resolution_note")) > 0)

profiles_avatar_consistency_check.name: profiles_avatar_consistency_check
profiles_avatar_consistency_check.value: ("profiles"."avatar_key" IS NULL AND "profiles"."avatar_updated_at" IS NULL) OR ("profiles"."avatar_key" IS NOT NULL AND "profiles"."avatar_updated_at" IS NOT NULL)

participation_events_from_shift_check.name: participation_events_from_shift_check
participation_events_from_shift_check.value: ("participation_events"."event_type" = 'changed' AND "participation_events"."from_shift_id" IS NOT NULL AND "participation_events"."from_shift_id" <> "participation_events"."shift_id") OR ("participation_events"."event_type" <> 'changed' AND "participation_events"."from_shift_id" IS NULL)

participation_events_status_transition_c.name: participation_events_status_transition_check
participation_events_status_transition_c.value: ("participation_events"."event_type" = 'attendance_corrected' AND "participation_events"."previous_status" IS NOT NULL AND "participation_events"."new_status" IS NOT NULL AND "participation_events"."previous_status" <> "participation_events"."new_status") OR ("participation_events"."event_type" <> 'attendance_corrected' AND "participation_events"."previous_status" IS NULL AND "participation_events"."new_status" IS NULL)

participation_events_reason_check.name: participation_events_reason_check
participation_events_reason_check.value: "participation_events"."event_type" NOT IN ('door_registered', 'attendance_manual', 'attendance_corrected') OR ("participation_events"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("participation_events"."reason")) > 0)

participations_status_fields_check.name: participations_status_fields_check
participations_status_fields_check.value: ("participations"."status" = 'booked' AND "participations"."attended_at" IS NULL AND "participations"."validated_by" IS NULL AND "participations"."attendance_method" IS NULL) OR ("participations"."status" = 'attended' AND "participations"."attended_at" IS NOT NULL)

opportunities_image_alt_check.name: opportunities_image_alt_check
opportunities_image_alt_check.value: "opportunities"."image_url" IS NULL OR ("opportunities"."image_alt" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("opportunities"."image_alt")) > 0)

opportunities_published_contact_check.name: opportunities_published_contact_check
opportunities_published_contact_check.value: "opportunities"."status" <> 'published' OR ("opportunities"."application_url" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("opportunities"."application_url")) > 0) OR ("opportunities"."contact_email" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("opportunities"."contact_email")) > 0)
